detailed_description:
Photoreal live-action, Ferrier's farm, Utah, 1860, low side sun, deep black shadow, 35 mm film grain.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:06. The shot begins from <Picture 2>: an insert on the deep window's blue-black glass beside the table: the lamp's flame reflected small and sharp in one pane, the dark log frame around it, and beyond the glass the faint pale line of the path running down to the gate under a sky a shade lighter than the hills; only what <Picture 2> shows is in frame. The camera is at the table's window end, level with the lamp chimney, an arm's length from the glass, a 90mm lens. The lamp behind the camera is the light and the glass gives back one small flame. At the first frame the window's dark log frame crosses the frame as two thick bars. The camera pushes in on the reflected flame across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth as the reflected flame leans once in the pane, from 00:00 to 00:03. At 00:03 a dark coat shoulder, the shoulder alone, comes in across the left of the glass as John <Subject 1> turns to the window, and the turn continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:06 the camera is pushing in on the reflected flame across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth through the last frame of the shot, and the action continues with it.
[Shot 2] From 00:06 to 00:08. At 00:06 the shot cuts to a medium close shot on <Subject 1>, beginning from <Picture 3>: head and shoulders, the laugh fallen from her face, the hazel eyes steady on her father at the left of frame, the chestnut hair gathered back, the lamp on one cheek, the blue-black window behind her shoulder. The camera is at the table side level with Lucy's eye, an arm's length from her, a 50mm lens. The lamp lights her from the left. At the first frame Lucy's head and shoulders fill the CENTRE of the frame from the TOP edge to the white collar at the BOTTOM third. The camera pushes in on Lucy across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth as she puts her chin up a finger's breadth toward her father, from 00:06 to 00:08. <Subject 1> (S1), on screen, a young woman of about twenty, with a clipped English voice at an even pace, says: <d>[English] But they won't let us leave.</d> His mouth shapes every syllable as the line is heard and closes on the last word. At 00:08, as the line ends, she turns her head a hand's breadth toward the blue-black window behind her shoulder, her face kept three-quarter to the lens, and the turn continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:08 the camera is pushing in on Lucy across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth through the last frame of the shot, and the action continues with it.
